$comment: K1 — every key in apps/web/src/locales/en.json classified by the register a translator needs. tests/i18n/registers.test.mjs fails if this does not cover en.json EXACTLY, so adding a string means deciding what it is. If that is why your build is red: add the key here. religious = NEVER AI-drafted. A wrong word there does not read awkwardly, it teaches a learner something false about recitation; those are Arabic technical terms whose Kurdish usage is established in some cases and contested in others, and choosing is a scholarly judgement. brand = never translated at all, in any language.

registers.ui: interface chrome — any fluent Sorani speaker can translate
registers.product: spaced repetition, consent and privacy semantics — needs a speaker who understands the concept
registers.religious: tajweed terminology and acts of worship — needs religious literacy; NOT AI-drafted
